responsibility: Primary handwritten backend implementation for the NVPTX target. This file owns most target hook logic that turns GCC’s generic middle-end and RTL representation into PTX-specific behavior: option override and attribute handling, calling convention and argument passing, symbol/memory-space encoding, assembly file emission and operand printing, builtin declaration and expansion, libcall and mode support, and OpenACC/OpenMP offloading support such as SIMT/vector parameters, gang/worker/vector shared-memory buffers, privatization, reductions, and fork/join handling. It is the central C++ implementation that cooperates with nvptx.md and nvptx.h to emit PTX assembly and target-specific offload code.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-stem nvptx files, this is the handwritten C++ implementation file that defines and wires up the NVPTX target hooks via TARGET_* macros and targetm, including PTX emission, builtin expansion, calling-convention handling, and OpenACC/OpenMP lowering support; by contrast nvptx.h provides compile-time target macros and data structures, nvptx.md supplies declarative RTL instruction patterns, and nvptx.opt defines target options.
